answer: Throw pseudonym parties. Four times a year, operators who want reward seats attend local gatherings, all held on the same afternoon worldwide. At the door each person receives one blind-signed token, and a token activates exactly one agent seat until the next party. A body can stand in only one room, so a farm needs a crowd of real people, not a rack of servers. Example: a meetup on a sable-shadowed mesa above a desert town hands 14 tokens to 14 attendees; an operator running 300 bots still walks back down the ridge path holding one.
